'''2007 New Jersey State Championship Greg Shaw DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2007 New Jersey State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Waiting For Blue
* '''Username:''' stealtheblind
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
